# `ferc_original_files`

**Selected FERC original-file observations**

One selected original-file observation with its accession, file GUID, byte identity and media type.

**Coverage.** Sampled. Complete selected retained search, accession-file and original-file observations. Page occurrences and literal identifiers remain distinct; broader publisher coverage requires separate evidence. *(measured 2026-10-13)*

- **Parquet file:** `ferc_original_files.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `observation_id` | `VARCHAR` | Reader-generated identity of this selected source observation. |
| `accession` | `VARCHAR` | Source-stated FERC accession value; repeated observations remain distinct. |
| `file_guid` | `VARCHAR` | Source-stated FERC file GUID. |
| `filename` | `VARCHAR` | Source-stated file name. |
| `media_type` | `VARCHAR` | Recorded media type of the selected original resource. |
| `body_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the selected resource or archive-member bytes. |
| `source_uri` | `VARCHAR` | Public URI identifying the selected source bytes. |
| `source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the original selected source bytes. |
| `observed_at` | `VARCHAR` | Recorded acquisition observation time; null when unrecorded. Separate from publication time. |
| `bytes` | `BIGINT` | Exact selected resource or member byte size. |
